name: MLX: An array framework for Apple silicon
notes: MLX is an array framework for ML on Apple silicon. Key features: NumPy-like Python API with C++/C/Swift APIs, composable function transformations (autodiff, vectorization, graph optimization), lazy computation, dynamic graph construction, multi-device (CPU+GPU), unified memory model. Inspired by NumPy, PyTorch, JAX, ArrayFire. 28.6k stars. The unified memory model eliminates data transfer between devices.
